---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
billboard_long <- tidyr::billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = readr::parse_number(week)) |>
  group_by(track, artist) |>
  mutate(weeks_on_chart = n()) |>
  ungroup()

longest_running <- billboard_long |>
  distinct(track, artist, weeks_on_chart) |>
  slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE)

billboard_long |>
  semi_join(longest_running, by = c("track", "artist", "weeks_on_chart")) |>
  ggplot(aes(week, rank, group = interaction(track, artist),
             color = weeks_on_chart)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 40, 60, 100)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, name = "Weeks\non chart") +
  labs(
    title = "Songs that wouldn't leave the charts",
    subtitle = "Weekly Billboard Hot 100 rank for the 12 longest-running tracks",
    x = "Week on the chart",
    y = "Billboard rank",
    caption = "Lower rank numbers are better"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#10131f", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#10131f", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#34384a"),
    text = element_text(color = "#f4f1de"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#c5c8d6"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "#ffcc66"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#c5c8d6"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#10131f", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#f4f1de"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#c5c8d6")
  )
```
